trigger.first_only: First observed eligible completed-entry same-cycle event satisfying portfolio DD and adverse price; if below exposure cap skip rest of cycle
trigger.cap_derivation: Existing S0 maximum BTC multiplier7.875/2; fixed hypothesis, not estimated optimum
trigger.busy_or_forced_ordinary_exit: Priority/block management; actual complete entry/ACK eligibility not certified by archived snapshots

cut.target_notional: 3.9375 * current finalized native equity frozen at claim
cut.target_quantity: target_notional / native mark, future implementation uses native instrument precision and held-quantity limits
cut.order: Existing native reduce-only MARKET IOC executor; ONE attempt per cycle, fixed absolute target
cut.partial: Only actual filled quantity becomes restoration credit; canceled leaves not assumed filled, no repeated percentage cut

restore.quantity_cap: At most actual protective filled quantity, existing original plan remaining entitlement and native margin; no synthetic funding/rights reset
restore.cut_reference: Actual completed protective attempt fill VWAP; no submitted target quantity credit
restore.confirmation: First fully closed post-cut15m candle with close beyond actual trimVWAP in original leg direction AND close above previous closed15m high (long) or below previous closed15m low (short)
restore.timing: Decision only after full candle closure; execute on next causal quote through existing native executor
restore.cancel_credit: Actual ordinary partial fill, NEW independent post-cut normal/forced exit decision, flat or changed cycle
restore.passive_TP_exception: Existing nonmarketable resting TP and technical recreation of same leaves do not cancel credit; marketable/queued/unknown ordinary states block restore; late ordinary fill invalidates credit before increase
restore.partial_restore: Actual fills only; unused canceled remainder not assumed filled or retried
restore.anchors: S0 initial plan/price references, parameters and consumed SOL notional remain original

anti_churn: No timer, no continuous rebalance, max ONEcut plus ONErestore attempt per cycle; no restore after ordinary exit
risk_scope: Common gross leg cap is not beta neutral, not equal asset risk and not a portfolio DD guarantee
precheck: 32 stored snapshots plus ONE bounded original-price diagnostic for20selected opportunities; no alternative equity or PnL
